title: 도시재정비 촉진을 위한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00120:20090421:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on the Construction, etc. of Bogeumjari Housing) <No. 120, April 21, 2009>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on the Promotion of Urban Renewal shall be amended as follows:

In the title of Article 7, "National Rental Housing" shall be replaced with "Bogeumjari Housing", and in the part of that Article other than the subparagraphs, "National Rental Housing" shall be replaced with "Bogeumjari Housing".

(2) through (4) Omitted.

Article 3 Omitted.
